rewrite.instruction: Rewrite this bug report as the short message a developer would type to a coding agent. 1–3 sentences, casual, may be vague or have typos, can mention a file or function name if a developer would know it. Do NOT say how hard it is, do NOT hint at severity or effort, do NOT include the solution. Output only the message.

control_arm._note: Pilot only: Sonnet 5 on the ORIGINAL issue text, to measure what the casual rewrite loses.
